infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Wingman shares your location with your group tonight so they can find you, and notices if you drift away from them.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Wingman keeps your group able to find you even when your screen is locked. Location is only shared during a night out you started or joined.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: Wingman keeps your group able to find you even when your screen is locked.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Wingman uses motion to notice a hard fall followed by stillness, so your friends can get to you.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Wingman records your short spoken answer to a check-in question so it can tell you're OK. Recordings are scored and deleted.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Wingman uses the camera to scan a friend's QR code to join their night out.
